ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low intensity black pixels concentrated at the axial center and along the trailing periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a dense triangular cluster at the median notch and a narrow, irregular band along the trailing edge. Discrete orange-brown focal blobs are visible in the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree internal angle, showing significant pixel depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the central trailing edge, becoming increasingly irregular and high-amplitude (jagged) toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge from notch to tip, meeting a convex leading edge at highly irregular distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected along the trailing edge and concentrated at the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deeply irregular, jagged tissue loss on the distal left tip, creating a sawtooth profile distinct from standard serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized orange-toned surface patches (potential diatom accumulation) on the ventral mid-lobes, distinct from the primary black-white pigmentation.
